title: Worked: arithmetic and powers of i

board_content.text: Warm-up: add, multiply, powers of i
Sum $=-1-i$. Divide the exponent by 4, keep the remainder.

segments_english.text: Let's put the arithmetic to work on a few quick examples, board level building up to the powers of i.
First, a pure addition. Three plus two i, plus minus six plus five i. Add real to real, imaginary to imaginary: minus three plus seven i. Done.
Now a product: two plus three i, times one minus four i. Expand it like any binomial: two, minus eight i, plus three i, minus twelve i squared.

Replace i squared with minus one, so minus twelve i squared becomes plus twelve. Collect: two plus twelve is fourteen, and minus eight i plus three i is minus five i. The answer is fourteen minus five i.
Next, powers. Evaluate i to the one hundred thirty five plus i to the minus fifty.
For the first, one hundred thirty five divided by four leaves remainder three, so i to the one hundred thirty five is i cubed, which is minus i.
For the second, the exponent is negative, so add fifty two to reach a positive multiple structure: minus fifty plus fifty two is two. So i to the minus fifty equals i squared equals minus one.
Add them: minus one, minus i. Notice the whole method is just: divide the exponent by four and keep the remainder.

segments_hinglish.text: Arithmetic ko kuch quick examples par kaam pe lagate hain, board level se shuru karke powers of i tak.
Pehle, pure addition. Three plus two i, plus minus six plus five i. Real ko real se, imaginary ko imaginary se add karo: minus three plus seven i. Ho gaya.
Ab ek product: two plus three i, times one minus four i. Kisi bhi binomial ki tarah expand karo: two, minus eight i, plus three i, minus twelve i squared.

i squared ko minus one se replace karo, to minus twelve i squared ban jaata hai plus twelve. Collect: two plus twelve is fourteen, aur minus eight i plus three i is minus five i. Answer hai fourteen minus five i.
Aage, powers. Nikaalo i to the one hundred thirty five plus i to the minus fifty.
Pehle wale mein, one hundred thirty five ko four se divide karne par remainder three, to i to the one hundred thirty five hai i cube, yaani minus i.
Doosre mein exponent negative hai, to fifty two add karke positive banao: minus fifty plus fifty two is two. To i to the minus fifty barabar i square barabar minus one.
Add karo: minus one, minus i. Dhyaan do, poora method bas ye hai: exponent ko four se divide karo aur remainder rakho.
